input_format: bounded HTTP/2 HEADERS sequence: initial request followed by trailer-shaped HEADERS on the same stream
configuration_profile: real HTTP/2 frame dispatch and HEADERS metadata validation with a live initial request stream
allocator_mode: fresh HTTP/2, stream and request pools per input
justification: The live request target covered only a new stream. This target supplies a second HEADERS frame using an already-open stream ID and tests nginx's repeated-HEADERS rejection boundary.
state: The first HEADERS frame creates a request stream and completes its HPACK block. The following trailer-shaped HEADERS frame re-enters ngx_http_v2_state_headers with sid <= last_sid, which must cause a connection PROTOCOL_ERROR before stream creation or HPACK decoding.
known_limitations: Current nginx rejects repeated HEADERS on an existing stream before decoding the second block; trailer field semantics are therefore not exercised.
The target uses one contiguous writable buffer and stops before routing, request-body processing and application phases.

scopes.contract: Complete one request header block, then reject a second HEADERS frame with the same stream ID before decoding its trailer-shaped HPACK block.
scopes.preconditions: First frame creates stream 1; second HEADERS frame also uses stream 1; bounded contiguous input and fresh pools.
